meta.title: Folder cards sidebar
meta.description: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a grid of portrait folder cards: a folder glyph plus the folder name by default, an inserted image when you pick one, and a droplet transition into that folder's session list with a back button and a collapsing ripple on the way out. Includes title and content search, card sorting (folder order / recent activity), the native session menu with a built-in fallback (rename, pin, fork, copy id, archive), and an expandable archived section.
